value.Title: Dr Stephen M Lyon
value.Description: Dr Stephen M Lyon is Professor of Anthropology and Head of Educational Programmes at the Aga Khan University's Institute for the Study of Muslim Civilisations​ in London. He is the author of numerous articles and books and is the Editor-in-Chief of the Social Science Computer Review. He tweets at @stelynews​.

value.Title: Dr Rozina Karmaliani
value.Description: ​Dr Rozina Karmaliani is the Dean of the Aga Khan University’s School of Nursing and Midwifery in Pakistan. She is the first alumna of the School to get a PhD in Nursing, which she received from the University of Minnesota. She tweets at @RKarmaliani.

value.Title: Dr Sulaiman Shahabuddin
value.Description: Dr Sulaiman Shahabuddin is President of the Aga Khan University. Previously, he served as Regional CEO of the Aga Khan Health Services in East Africa. He holds a Doctor of Health Administration degree from Central Michigan University, USA.

value.Title: Dr Anil Khamis
value.Description: ​Dr Anil Khamis is a faculty member and the SDGs focal point at the Aga Khan University. He is also a faculty member at the University College London Institute of Education where he has been since 2001. He holds a PhD in Education and International Development from the University of London.

value.Title: Dr. Asad I Mian
value.Description: Dr Asad I Mian​, Director, CCIT​;​ Professor & Chair, ​Department of Emergency Medicine; AKU​​

value.Title: Mahrukh Jiwa
value.Description: ​Mahrukh Jiwa is an educationist, researcher, teacher trainer and developer of instructional materials. She is serving at the Aga Khan University Examination Board as Specialist, Middle School Programme.

value.Title: ​Ambreen Merchant
value.Description: ​Ambreen Merchant is currently working as a Nursing Faculty at School of Nursing and Midwifery, Aga Khan University. Her areas of interest are educational research, gender-based violence, leadership and management in nursing and patient care research.

value.Title: Momina Abid
value.Description: ​Momina Abid is an Economics & Political Science graduate from the Lahore University of Management Sciences. She is currently working as Assistant Manager – Digital Learning at The Citizens Foundation, and recently completed her two-year Fellowship at Teach For Pakistan.

value.Title: ​Shanaz Cassum
value.Description: ​Shanaz Cassum is an Assistant Professor at AKU' SONAM. She received the Award for Innovation in Teaching Practice in recognition of her outstanding teaching and academic pursuits at AKU’s Global Convocation 2021.​

value.Title: Neha Raheel
value.Description: Neha Raheel is a Fulbright scholar and has a Master’s in Education, Culture, and Society from the University of Pennsylvania. She is currently working at The Citizens Foundation (TCF), where she leads curriculum and assessment design for Public-Private Partnership schools. She tweets at @NehaRaheel.

value.Title: Aftab Hussain Rajper
value.Description: ​Aftab Hussain Rajper is currently pursuing a MPhil in Education from AKU-IED and working as a Head Teacher at a government school in Tahsil Faiz Gunj in the K​hairpur Mir district of Sindh. Aftab holds a LLB, Masters in English and Masters in Education from Shah Abdul Latif University, Khairpur.​

value.Title: Professor Marleen Temmerman
value.Description: Professor Marleen Temmerman is the Director of AKU's Centre of Excellence in Women and Child Health, East Africa, and a global leader in women, child and adolescent health. She tweets at @MamaDaktari

value.Title: Talha Nadeem
value.Description: ​Talha Nadeem is the Communications Specialist with the Office of Student Affairs and Services (SAAS)​. ​He assists students with their communications initiatives and runs all communications for projects and programmes.

value.Title: Publication and Literary Society
value.Description: ​The Publications and Literary Society​ provides a platform to help students develop and market their love of literature and language, ranging from narrative prose to the spoken word. Along with organizing competitions and activities, its flagship magazine 'Magminimus' encourages students to express themselves creatively.​

value.Title: Dr Asad I Mian
value.Description: ​Dr Asad I Mian​, ​an AKU alumnus and the Director of Critical Creative Innovative Thinking (CCIT) at the institution.​​

value.Title: Farhana Alarakhiya
value.Description: ​Farhana Alarakhiya, Chief Data Innovation Officer, Aga Khan University

value.Title: Tashmin Khamis
value.Description: ​Tashmin Khamis is the Vice Provost and Founding Director of the Network of Quality, Teaching and Learning at the Aga Khan University.

value.Title: Ibrahim Mohsin & Asad Mian MD, PHD
value.Description: Ibrahim Mohsin is a fourth year medical student at AKU interested in pursuing a career in Emergency Medicine. Asad Mian MD, PhD is Professor of Emergency Medicine at AKU.

value.Title: Sharon Theo Nzau
value.Description: ​Sharon Theo Nzau, a first-year undergraduate medical student at The Aga Khan University in Kenya. She loves playing the guitar and writing poems. Her favourite places on campus are Kiva, Room 405, and the Knowledge Garden. Her friends find her funny, extroverted, and kind.

value.Title: Rowing Club
value.Description: ​Established in 2023, the AKU Rowing Club​ aims to represent AKU in rowing regattas and foster​ a sense of community and competition among students.

value.Title: Sports Society
value.Description:
​The AKU Sports Society organizes sporting events throughout the academic year, promoting friendly competition and fostering skills in organization and leadership.
​

value.Title: Arts and Culture Committee
value.Description: The Arts and Culture Committee​ orchestrates cultural events for its class and student community, ranging from picnics and T 1/2-series to movie nights, Karaoke, ​and Independence Day.​

value.Title: Falah
value.Description: ​Founded in 1993 by MBBS students, Falah​ focuses on patient welfare. A dedicated wing in the School of Nursing and Midwifery supports fundraising efforts.​

value.Title: Aurora
value.Description: Aurora​ is a student-run mental health and well-being body that aims to promote psychological well-being amongst all AKU students.

value.Title: Office of Student Experience - Pakistan
value.Description:
The Office of Student Experience - Pakistan​ supports students’ personal and professional development by creating an environment that fosters student engagement  ​
​​​​​​​​​

value.Title: Theodora Dame
value.Description: ​Dr Theodora Dame Adjin-Tettey is a Senior Lecturer in the Department of Media, Language and Communication at Durban University of Technology, South Africa.

value.Title: Fiona Wachera
value.Description: ​The author is a Storytelling and Content Specialist at the Aga Khan University. Fiona Wachera is a journalist and photo editor, writing a column on African photography called "Postcolonial Perspectives".

value.Title: Patricia Njeri
value.Description: Patricia Njeri, founder of Birth and Beyond, empowers marginalized teenage mothers. Through her initiative, she's distributed over 1500 dignity kits, creating a space for these young women to thrive.​

value.Title: Brenda Nyamichaba
value.Description: ​She ​​​is a Communication Officer at the School of Nursing and Midwifery, Aga Khan University EA. With a background in media and communications, she is passionate about the power of effective storytelling. ​​

value.Title: Anum Zulfiquar Ali & Afra Khan
value.Description:
​Anum is an MPhil in Education student at AKU-IED, whose passion lies in the realm of English pedagogy. Anum has served as a language specialist at an ed-tech startup, where she developed her skills in creating captivating instructional learning materials. Not stopping there, she dedicated her time as a secondary-grade English teacher at an underprivileged school, where she also took on the role of project head for the middle school project. With her passion and expertise, Anum is on a mission to make language learning not only accessible but also enjoyable for all.​

Afra is a passionate BS English (Literature) student at the College of Languages, Literature, and Culture. With a strong academic record and a background in science, she brings a unique interdisciplinary perspective to her studies. Afra has worked as a Research Assistant to the Assistant Commissioner at NAB, gaining valuable insight into administrative and analytical work. A confident multilingual communicator, she excels in presentations, collaborative discussions, and team-based tasks. Currently preparing for competitive examinations with a vision to serve the nation through knowledge and integrity.

value.Title: Dianah Otieno
value.Description: Creative storyteller & digital strategist focused on gender and child health advocacy: blending design, marketing, and behavioural insights to craft campaigns that inspire change​

value.Title: Shafi Ullah
value.Description: ​Shafi Ullah is an MSc Nursing student at AKU and a Clinical Nurse at the Aga Khan University Hospital, Karachi. He has nearly three years of nursing experience and is committed to cardiovascular disease prevention research.

value.Title: Abida Sifat
value.Description: ​Abida Sifat (MScN student and Clinical Nurse in cardiac care unit). My objective is to utilize my writing to establish a connection between clinical practice and technological advancements. ​

value.Title: Faryaal Khalid, Aisha Naz Ansari, Dr Sadia Bhutta
value.Description:
​Dr Sadia Bhutta is working as an Associate Professor at Aga Khan University Institute for Educational Development, Pakistan. Her research interests include classroom practice, learning outcomes, and quantitative research methods.

Faryaal Khalid holds a Master's degree in English Linguistics from the University of Karachi and is currently pursuing her MPhil at Iqra University. She has taught as visiting faculty for several years and has previously served as the Academic Support and Content Specialist and the Assistant Manager for the B.Ed. programme at the AKU-IED. Currently, she works as a Research Specialist at AKU-IED where she is involved in a large-scale education project aimed at improving learning outcomes for communities across Pakistan.

Aisha Naz Ansari is a Research Specialist at the Aga Khan University, Institute for Educational Development, Pakistan, and an Associate Fellow of Advance HE, UK. She is a member of the ESIC Working Group on AI for Evidence Synthesis under Cochrane Collaborations. She has conducted and published research in the areas of educational technology, teacher education, AI in higher education, systematic reviews, public-private partnerships, and classroom teaching and learning. To date, she has 30 research publications to her credit.​

value.Title: Faryaal Khalid and Dr. Nasima Shakeel
value.Description:
​Faryaal Khalid holds a Master's degree in English Linguistics from the University of Karachi and is currently pursuing her MPhil at Iqra University. She has taught as a visiting faculty for several years and has previously served as the Academic Support and Content Specialist and the Assistant Manager for the B.Ed. programme at the AKU-IED. Currently, she works as a Research Specialist at AKU-IED where she is involved in a large-scale education project funded by KIX aimed at improving learning outcomes for communities across Pakistan.

Dr. Nasima Shakeel is an Assistant Professor at the Aga Khan University, Institute for Educational Development (AKU-IED). An alumna of AKU-IED, she specializes in gender equity in early childhood education and educational leadership and management. With rich experience working with children, parents, and teachers across Pakistan, she is deeply committed to inclusive and equitable education. Currently, she is the Principal Investigator of the SIPCA project funded by KIX.​

value.Title: Maria Kisanko
value.Description: ​Maria Chilipachi Kisanko is a Marketing and Communications Coordinator at Aga Khan University's Institute for Educational Development, East Africa. She leads strategic communication and outreach efforts across education and health sectors, supporting various AKU entities in Tanzania.

value.Title: Safiya Dina
value.Description: ​Safiya Dina, a Research and Communications Assistant at Aga Khan University, is completing her Master's in Global Health at McMaster University. Passionate about maternal health, she advocates for equitable access to quality care.​

value.Title: Maxwel Anekea
value.Description: ​Maxwel Anekea is a Communications Officer at AKU-SONAM EA. He is passionate about impactful storytelling that highlights progress in health, education, and research.​

value.Title: Dr Selina Hasan
value.Description: Dr Selina Hasan is Advisor, Simulation Education at The Aga Khan University Centre for Innovation in Medical Education (AKU-CIME), Karachi. Her areas of expertise are gamification, distance simulation and curriculum development.

value.Title: Banafsha Saeed
value.Description: ​Banafsha Saeed hails from Northern Pakistan. She is an undergraduate student at Aga Khan University’s Faculty of Arts and Science, majoring in Environmental Sciences. Her interests lie in climate resilience, community-based sustainability, and environmental policy.

value.Title: Didar Ali
value.Description: ​Didar Ali hails from Gilgit Baltistan. He is an undergraduate student in Politics Philosophy Economics (PPE) at Aga Khan University’s Faculty of Arts and Science. He is passionate about climate action, community development, and exploring how local voices can shape global conversations around justice, sustainability, and social change.

value.Title: Tayyab Hussain
value.Description:
​About the Author

Tayyab Hussain is an English instructor and an MPhil Education scholar from the class of 2026 at AKU IED, Pakistan. Beyond classroom teaching, he has a real appetite for learning modern Ed-tech tools to create interactive learning environments. He believes in the power of a one-touch button world, but at the same time, he suggests to use a balanced approach between technological and analog education systems.​

value.Title: Dr Sadia Bhutta, Wadhwani Nimarta, Khadija Gul and Afsar Uddin.
value.Description:
​About Authors

Wadhwani Nimarta

Nimarta is a M.Phil graduate and a budding researcher working as a Senior Research Assistant in a nation-wide study funded by DARE-RC at Aga Khan University Institute for Educational Development (AKU-IED). She holds an experience of working on similar funded projects. Her own research area focuses on School structures and Teacher Agency.

Khadija Gul

Khadija Gul is a Senior Research Assistant at the Aga Khan University Institute for Educational Development (AKU-IED). Her research primarily focuses on education policy, with a particular emphasis on the implementation of the school Clustering Policy. Her other areas of interest include educational policy, mental health, and English language and literature teaching. She also writes on these areas as blogs and newspaper columns.

Afsar Uddin

Afsar Uddin is an MPhil graduate from the Aga Khan University – Institute for Educational Development (AKU-IED). He currently serves as a principal with the Elementary and Secondary Education Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, based in Chitral. Alongside his administrative role, Afsar is also associated with the Aga Khan University as a part-time research associate, contributing to a research project focused on gender-based violence in Pakistani colleges. His professional interests lie in educational leadership, equity, and community-centered school development.

Sadia Bhutta

Dr Sadia Bhutta is working as an Associate Professor at Aga Khan University Institute for Educational Development, Pakistan. Her research interests include classroom practice, learning outcomes, and quantitative research methods.
​

value.Title: Jenna Sara Khoja and Kiran Qasim Ali
Banafsha and Didar
value.Description: ​Banafsha Saeed and Didar Ali are undergraduate students at Aga Khan University's Faculty of Arts and Science, majoring in Environmental Sciences and Politics Philosophy Economics (PPE) respectively.

value.Title: Maureen Ooko
value.Description: ​​Maureen Ooko is the communications coordinator at the Institute for Human Development. She derives joy in crafting feature stories that highlight the value and impact of scientific research and evidence-based interventions.

value.Title: Professor Emmanuel Sulle
value.Description: ​Professor Emmanuel Sulle is an Assistant Professor, Faculty of Arts and Sciences, Karachi and Director of Arusha Climate and Environmental Research Centre (AKU-ACER). He is well-known as a leading scholar on agrarian studies in Africa and a contributor to the Network of Excellence on Land Governance in Africa.

value.Title: Rachel Baldwin
value.Description: ​Rachel Baldwin is the Vice Provost, Students at the Aga Khan University. She is responsible for the strategic growth, management, and evolution of all student affairs related offices and services at AKU.

value.Title: Dr Salim Surani
value.Description: ​Dr Salim Surani is a Clinical Professor at the University of Houston, a Yale MPH graduate, and a Master Clinician. A prolific researcher and mentor, he has authored 500+ articles and 100 book chapters.

value.Title: Dr Faisal Ismail
value.Description: ​Dr Faisal Ismail is the Regional Director for AKU's Centre for Innovation in Medical Education, South Asia.

value.Title: Farhana Alarakhiya
value.Description: ​Farhana Alarakhiya is a seasoned Softw​are Executive with over 25 years of experience in the world of Big Data and AI. Currently serving as the Chief​ Data Innovation Officer, Farhana is using data to drive impactful change in LMICs.  She is the Chief Data Innovation Officer at Aga Khan University's Data Innovation Office.

value.Title: Peter Silas Mangi
value.Description: ​Student Recruitment Specialist for Aga Khan University School of Nursing and Midwifery (SONAM) in Tanzania. Passionate about connecting future nurses with transformative education and leadership opportunities.

value.Title: Dr Michael Moneypenny
value.Description: ​Dr Michael Moneypenny is Regional Director (East Africa) at AKU's Centre for Innovation in Medical Education (CIME); former President, ASPiH, and former Director, Scottish Centre for Simulation & Clinical Human Factors.

value.Title: Vincent Mariita
value.Description: ​Vincent Mariita is a communications professional who contributes to storytelling at Aga Khan University's School of Nursing and Midwifery EA, with interests in health, education, science, and research communication.

value.Title: Mary Gitonga
value.Description: ​Mary Gitonga is a Manager, ERP Financial Applications – Financial Control Department at Aga Khan University Hospital, Nairobi.
